title: Hostage-Taking Incident on Valiasr Street, Tehran
text:
Hostage-Taking Incident on Valiasr Street, Tehran"

"Tehran Police Command:"

"This morning, following reports of a hostage situation on Valiasr Street, just north of Saei Park, the incident was reported to the police via the 110 emergency call center."

"Thanks to the timely arrival of law enforcement forces, the hostage was freed and the hostage-taker was subdued.
